note: Candidate task pool for the nightly train loop. OPERATOR-EDITABLE. The loop NEVER selects the golden set (references/golden/ — the frozen eval gate) and NEVER acts on a real customer / live production system: every task here is a sandbox/test build-or-harden of OUR OWN tooling, and any live change waits for operator approval. Each task: id, kind (harden|backlog|distill), title, surface (maps to a golden case type for the eval), verifier, est_usd, attempts[] (prior {success} results → frontier band). 'status' (done|in_progress|blocked) excludes a task from selection.
